{"metadata":{"description":"训练 RVC 音色模型：素材体检→切片→特征提取→训练→建索引→验收→部署全流程。修复 RVC 20240604 归一化缺陷。仅用于训练新音色；切换/使用已有音色或 TTS 播放问题无需加载。","id":"gh:1433458401","install_available":false,"language":"Python","name":"vc-voice-train-skill","slug":"zabuxie/vc-voice-train-skill","topics":["deepseek-harness","dsh","dsh-plugin","rvc","skill","tts","voice-cloning"]},"paragraphs":[{"id":"p1s1","text":"训练 RVC 音色模型：素材体检→切片→特征提取→训练→建索引→验收→部署全流程。修复 RVC 20240604 归一化缺陷。仅用于训练新音色；切换/使用已有音色或 TTS 播放问题无需加载。"},{"id":"p2s1","text":"# vc-voice-train-skill"},{"id":"p3s1","text":"Make your AI speak in someone's voice — two routes, pick by need:"},{"id":"p4s1","text":"- **RVC training** — train a model from voice clips; best timbre accuracy, same-language.
- **IndexT"},{"id":"p4s2","text":"TS zero-shot** — synthesize straight from a reference clip; **the only sane choice for cross-languag"},{"id":"p4s3","text":"ero-shot** — synthesize straight from a reference clip; **the only sane choice for cross-language**."},{"id":"p5s1","text":"DSH 技能：让 AI 用指定人物的声音说话。两条路线："},{"id":"p6s1","text":"- **RVC 训练** —— 用素材训模型，音色准，适合同语种；
- **IndexTTS 零样本** —— 给一段参考音频直接合成，**跨语种首选**。"},{"id":"p7s1","text":"## Which one? / 怎么选"},{"id":"p8s1","text":"| Need | Use | Why |"},{"id":"p9s1","text":"| Foreign-language source, want Chinese output | **IndexTTS** | RVC has no Chinese phonemes → choppy"},{"id":"p9s2","text":" |
| Source language == target language | **RVC** | trained, more accurate timbre |
| Precise pitch "},{"id":"p9s3","text":"control | **RVC** | pitch comes from the driver audio |
| No training budget | **IndexTTS** | one re"},{"id":"p9s4","text":"ference clip is enough |"},{"id":"p10s1","text":"> Measured on the same source (Japanese CV clips, Chinese output):
> RVC = choppy · IndexTTS = natur"},{"id":"p10s2","text":"al but ~90 Hz too high (fixable via reference selection)."},{"id":"p11s1","text":"## What's inside / 包含什么"},{"id":"p12s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p13s1","text":"## Why / 为什么需要这个 skill"},{"id":"p14s1","text":"Both RVC and IndexTTS fail in ways that look like "the model is just bad", with no error:"},{"id":"p15s1","text":"**RVC 20240604** never normalizes audio (`audio_norm = audio`, normalization commented out).
16-bit "},{"id":"p15s2","text":"PCM hits `spectrogram_torch()` ~32768× too large → generator latent space is polluted →
**output is "},{"id":"p15s3","text":"broadband noise**. The failure is masked by `if loss_mel > 75: loss_mel = 75`,
so training logs look"},{"id":"p15s4","text":" normal. Detection: `loss_disc` is **1e8+** instead of 2–6."},{"id":"p16s1","text":"**IndexTTS** has no such defect, but three things bite:"},{"id":"p17s1","text":"- Output pitch ≈ **reference pitch**. Pick a shrill reference and every sentence sounds shrill.
Meas"},{"id":"p17s2","text":"ured: reference 396 Hz → output 441 Hz; reference 313 Hz → output 320 Hz.
- Random sampling makes **"},{"id":"p17s3","text":"tone contours wobble**. The 4th tone (去声) slope measured
−7.7 / −1.8 / **−0.2** across runs — the −0"},{"id":"p17s4","text":".2 case is audibly "flat".
Setting `do_sample=False` alone does **not** fix it; you must also pin th"},{"id":"p17s5","text":"e RNG seed.
- On 8 GB cards the built-in low-VRAM chunking splits every 40 characters, which mangles"},{"id":"p17s6","text":"
pauses. Raising the threshold to 90 helps; disabling chunking entirely produces a
**12.7-second dea"},{"id":"p17s7","text":"d tail** on long inputs."},{"id":"p18s1","text":"## Quick start / 快速开始"},{"id":"p19s1","text":"### RVC"},{"id":"p20s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p21s1","text":"### IndexTTS"},{"id":"p22s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p23s1","text":"Point dsh-plugin-tts at provider "Index-TTS2", address `http://127.0.0.1:7880`."},{"id":"p24s1","text":"### Plugin patches（可选）"},{"id":"p25s1","text":"Two unified diffs for `@memef1f1y/dsh-plugin-tts@0.6.7`:"},{"id":"p26s1","text":"- `patches-index.mjs.diff` — host side:
- **language auto-switch**: a `zh-CN` voice cannot read kana"},{"id":"p26s2","text":" (measured: 0.24 s of
near-silence vs 2.6 s correct). Detects kana / hangul / cyrillic / arabic / th"},{"id":"p26s3","text":"ai in
the text and picks the matching Edge driver voice per request.
- **`/dsh-tts-api/backend-contr"},{"id":"p26s4","text":"ol`**: start / stop either backend, resolve its PID
from the listening port, and report `lang-patch`"},{"id":"p26s5","text":" status.
- **`lang-patch-status` / `lang-patch-restore`**: DSH reinstalls `node_modules` on
restart,"},{"id":"p26s6","text":" which silently reverts manual patches. These actions detect that and
restore from `index.mjs.langpa"},{"id":"p26s7","text":"tch.bak`.
- `patches-client.js.diff` — UI: a "快速切换后端" button that stops one backend, starts
the othe"},{"id":"p26s8","text":"r (they cannot share an 8 GB card), switches the provider, waits for
readiness, and shows live statu"},{"id":"p26s9","text":"are an 8 GB card), switches the provider, waits for
readiness, and shows live status + patch health."},{"id":"p27s1","text":"Apply from the package root (`patch -p1`, Git Bash / WSL / `patch.exe`):"},{"id":"p28s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p29s1","text":"## Requirements / 环境要求"},{"id":"p30s1","text":"| Item | RVC route | IndexTTS route |"},{"id":"p31s1","text":"| Bundle | **RVC 20240604 Nvidia** (verified; defect may not exist elsewhere) | IndexTTS-2.5 |
| GPU"},{"id":"p31s2","text":" VRAM | 32k: ≥8 GB · 40k: **≥12 GB** | **≥6 GB** (8 GB works) |
| RAM | — | **≥16 GB** (model load u"},{"id":"p31s3","text":"ses ~5 GB) |
| Python | 3.9.13 (bundled) | **3.10–3.11 only** |
| Disk | ~10 GB | ~20 GB |
| Paths |"},{"id":"p31s4","text":" **ASCII only** | ASCII only |"},{"id":"p32s1","text":"## Key signals / 关键信号"},{"id":"p33s1","text":"| Signal | Healthy | Broken |"},{"id":"p34s1","text":"| RVC `loss_disc` | **2–6** | **1e8+** → audio_norm defect |
| RVC `loss_mel` | 10–30, decreasing | "},{"id":"p34s2","text":"pinned at `75.000` (hard clamp) |
| RVC harmonic purity | within 0.05 of truth | higher → over-smoot"},{"id":"p34s3","text":"hed ("电音") |
| IndexTTS output pitch / P90 | close to reference | reference too shrill |
| IndexTTS "},{"id":"p34s4","text":"repeatability | 3 runs → identical MD5 | seed not pinned |"},{"id":"p35s1","text":"> `flat` (spectral flatness) is **not** a universal metric. Measured counterexamples:
> a rejected m"},{"id":"p35s2","text":"odel had **flat 0.040** (lowest) while a user-approved one had **0.21** (over
> the usual 0.15 thres"},{"id":"p35s3","text":"hold). Always compare against ground truth."},{"id":"p36s1","text":"## Notes / 注意"},{"id":"p37s1","text":"- Voice models trained from copyrighted material stay under the original rights holder.
This repo sh"},{"id":"p37s2","text":"ips **no audio and no models** — methods only.
- Verified on Windows + RTX 4060 Laptop 8 GB (32k RVC"},{"id":"p37s3","text":", IndexTTS) and RTX 3060 12 GB (40k RVC).
- The two backends **cannot run simultaneously on an 8 GB "},{"id":"p37s4","text":"card** (IndexTTS ~5 GB + RVC ~2–3 GB)."},{"id":"p38s1","text":"## License"},{"id":"p39s1","text":"MIT for scripts and docs. RVC and IndexTTS follow their own licenses."}],"truncated":false}
